summary.headline: Treya Partnership secures $412K in annual savings for SaVida Health across 5 spend areas
summary.narrative: Since kicking off in October 2024, Treya Partners has delivered a validated $358K annual win through an EMR renegotiation and has lined up a further $54K through a GPO transition, IT-hardware price reductions, and a telecom consolidation. Five categories reached contracting or late-stage negotiation, with the Athena EMR agreement already signed and in force. Additional savings from the Provista GPO, hardware VAR leverage, and Comcast managed-services rollout are slated for completion once roster true-ups and final signatures are wrapped up.

category_results.status_notes: Contract executed 4/15/2025; fee reduced from 4.56 % to 3.40 % delivering $358K net annual savings.
Provista participation agreement signed 5/5/2025; waiting on SKU-level validation and roster upload.
Same Provista agreement covers medical supplies; savings range narrowed to $28K pending confirmation of temp-strip cup pricing.
Alternative specs priced through Connection VAR showing 13 % savings; next step is to leverage pricing with CDW via Provista.
Spend analysis complete; Comcast managed-services proposal under review, consolidation expected to yield 15-20 % savings.

time_to_value.notes: First hard-dollar savings realized within 6 months via EMR renegotiation.

impact.operational_improvements: Consolidated EMR contract terms for simpler administration, initiated migration to a national GPO for unified pricing, and scoped a managed-services telecom model to centralize bandwidth and support.

proof_points.statement: Renegotiated Athena EMR fee from 4.56 % to 3.40 %, immediately saving $358K per year.
